Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the floor. 3. Keep your body straight and relax your shoulders, letting your weight gently stretch your back. 4. Hold the position for the time you want, breathing in a controlled way.

Slowly lower the dumbbells to the starting position and repeat.

Slowly lower the bar to the starting position, controlling the movement.

A un ritmo en el que puedas hablar sin a: Go at a pace where you can talk without gasping. If you need to stop, stop and carry on when you can: what counts is the total time.
Abdomen y la musculatura que sujeta la e: Abs and the muscles that support your back.
Abdomen, sobre todo la parte baja, y fle: Abs, especially the lower part, and hip flexors.
Abrir demasiado atrás (estira en exceso: Going too far back (overstretches the shoulder).
Abrir demasiado atrás y forzar el hombro: Opening too far back and straining your shoulder.
Flaring your elbows out to 90 degrees from your body.
Flaring your elbows out to the sides.

Letting your elbows flare out as you lower.

Acuéstate boca abajo con los brazos exte: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you and your legs straight. Inhale and simultaneously lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor, keeping your neck aligned. Hold the position for a few seconds, feeling the contraction in your lower back. Exhale and slowly lower your arms, chest and legs to the floor.
Acuéstate boca abajo en el suelo con las: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended. Place your palms on the floor at shoulder height. Inhale and slowly lift your chest, keeping your hips on the floor. Hold the position for 15-30 seconds, then lower gently.
Acuéstate boca abajo en la máquina de cu: Lie face down on the leg curl machine, adjusting the pad so it sits just above your ankles. Grab the side handles to stabilize yourself and line your knees up with the machine's pivot. Bend your knees, bringing the pad toward your glutes while keeping the movement controlled. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position without letting the weight drop abruptly.
Acuéstate boca abajo en una máquina de e: Lie face down on a back extension machine, securing your ankles under the rollers. Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head. Slowly raise your torso until it lines up with your legs, keeping your back straight. Lower back to the start with control, without arching your back.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las manos detr: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs raised. Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while you extend your right leg. Alternate by bringing your left elbow toward your right knee, keeping a steady rhythm.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las piernas el: Lie on your back with your legs raised and your knees slightly bent. Place your hands behind your head, keeping your elbows wide. Contract your abs and lift your shoulders off the floor, bringing your chest toward your knees. Slowly lower your shoulders to the floor without letting your legs drop.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las piernas ex: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Place your hands under your glutes for extra support. Lift both legs a few inches off the floor. Alternate crossing your legs, one over the other, keeping your abs contracted.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las piernas le: Lie on your back with your legs raised and your knees bent at 90 degrees. Extend your arms toward the ceiling, keeping your lower back pressed into the floor. Slowly lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor without touching it. Return to the starting position and repeat with your left arm and right leg.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las rodillas d: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Place your arms at your sides with your palms down. Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your hips to the floor.

Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head without interlacing your fingers. Lift your torso toward your knees using your abs, keeping your back straight. Slowly lower back to the starting position without letting your body drop.

Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head, without pulling on your neck. Contract your abs and lift your shoulders off the floor, keeping your lower back in contact with the floor. Slowly lower your shoulders back to the floor and repeat.
Acuéstate boca arriba en un banco plano: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle. Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended. Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Extend your arms up, palms facing each other, with a slight bend in your elbows. Slowly lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest. Return to the starting position by squeezing your chest, and repeat.
Acuéstate boca arriba en un banco plano,: Lie on your back on a flat bench, holding a bar with your hands shoulder-width apart. Extend your arms straight up, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Lower the bar slowly toward your forehead, staying in control. Return to the start by extending your arms without locking your elbows.
Acuéstate boca arriba en un banco, agarr: Lie on your back on a bench, gripping the edge with your hands. Raise your legs and hips up, keeping your body straight. Slowly lower your body without touching the bench, controlling the movement.
Acuéstate boca arriba en un banco, con l: Lie on your back on a bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Hold one dumbbell with both hands, arms extended over your chest. Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows slightly bent. Return to the start, making sure you control the movement.
Acuéstate de lado con las piernas extend: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked. Rest your forearm on the floor, with your elbow aligned under your shoulder. Lift your hips until you form a straight line from your feet to your head. Hold the position, making sure your hips don't sag.
Acuéstate en el banco con los pies firme: Lie on the bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Slowly lower the bar until it lightly touches your chest. Press the bar up until your arms are fully extended.
Acuéstate en un banco plano con los pies: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Grip the bar with a narrow grip, hands about shoulder-width apart. Lower the bar slowly to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body. Press the bar up until your arms are fully extended.
Pushing your shoulder forward to help.
Adelantar la rodilla de delante por enci: Letting your front knee travel past your toes.
Adelantar las caderas por delante de las: Letting your hips drift forward past your knees.
Adelantar los codos al final del recorri: Pushing your elbows forward at the end of the movement.
Adelantar los hombros y quedarte de punt: Letting your shoulders drift forward and ending up on your toes.
Agarra la barra con las palmas mirando h: Grab the bar with your palms facing forward, shoulder-width apart. Hang with your arms fully extended, then pull your body up until your chin clears the bar. Lower yourself under control to the starting position.
Agarra la barra de dominadas con las man: Grab the pull-up bar with your hands shoulder-width apart. Hang with your arms extended and your body straight, without swinging. Raise your legs together toward your chest, staying in control. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position.
Agarra las barras paralelas con las palm: Grab the parallel bars with your palms facing in. Lift your body until your arms are straight. Lower your body slowly, leaning slightly forward. Push up to return to the start.
Agarrar la barra con las muñecas rígidas: Gripping the bar with stiff wrists and not letting it lower.
Agarrarte a los pasamanos y descargar el: Holding on to the handrails and taking weight off your legs.
Aguantar hasta que se te van los brazos: Holding on until your arms give out and you fall backward.
Aguantar la respiración (espira al estir: Holding your breath (breathe out as you stretch your arm and leg).
Aguantar la respiración; espira en el es: Holding your breath; breathe out on the effort.
Ajusta el asiento de la máquina para que: Adjust the machine seat so the handles are at chest height. Sit with your back against the pad and grab the handles with your elbows slightly bent. Exhale as you bring the handles together in front of you, keeping your elbows in the same position. Inhale as you slowly return to the starting position without letting the weights clank together.

Adjust the machine seat so the handles are at shoulder height. Sit with your back straight and your feet firmly on the floor. Grip the handles with your palms facing forward and press up until your arms are extended. Slowly return to the starting position without letting the weight stack touch down.
Ajusta el asiento para que las manijas e: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height. Sit with your back straight and your feet firmly on the floor. Push the handles forward until your arms are extended, without locking your elbows. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta el asiento y coloca las rodillas: Adjust the seat and place your knees under the pad. Grab the bar with a close grip, palms facing you. Pull the bar down until it touches your upper chest, keeping your back straight. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta el asiento y el respaldo para que: Adjust the seat and backrest so your knees line up with the machine's pivot. Place your feet under the padded rollers, making sure your ankles are comfortable. Slowly extend your legs until they are almost straight, without locking your knees. Return to the starting position in a controlled way, keeping tension in your quads.

Adjust the seat and backrest so your knees line up with the pivot of the pads. Sit down and place your legs against the outer pads, making sure your feet are firmly on the floor. Push the pads outward with your legs, keeping your torso upright and controlling the movement. Slowly return to the starting position without letting the pads snap together.

Adjust the seat and backrest so your knees form a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the platform. Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform and make sure they are planted firmly. Push the platform up by extending your legs, but don't lock your knees. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta el asiento y el soporte para los: Adjust the seat and the footrest to your height. Sit with your back straight and grab the handles with a firm grip. Pull the handles toward your torso, keeping your elbows close to your body. Slowly return to the starting position without losing tension.
Ajusta el asiento y la almohadilla para: Adjust the seat and the thigh pad to your height. Hold the bar with a neutral grip, palms facing each other. Pull the bar down until it touches your upper chest, keeping your back straight. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

Adjust the seat and the thigh pad, making sure your feet are planted firmly on the floor. Grip the bar with a wide grip, palms facing forward. Pull the bar down until it lightly touches your upper chest, keeping your back straight and your elbows out to the sides. Slowly return the bar to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta el asiento y la resistencia a tu: Adjust the seat and the resistance to your level. Place your feet on the footplates and hold the handle with both hands. Push with your legs as you pull the handle toward your chest. Return to the starting position by extending your arms and bending your knees.
Ajusta el asiento y las almohadillas par: Adjust the seat and the pads to fit your legs. Sit down and place your legs against the pads, making sure they line up with your knees. Slowly squeeze your legs together, staying in control throughout the movement. Return to the starting position in a controlled way, without letting the pads clank together.

Adjust the seat and pads so your arms are at 90 degrees at the start. Grab the handles with a firm, comfortable grip. Press down until your arms are almost straight, staying in control. Slowly return to the starting position without locking your elbows.
Ajusta el asiento y respaldo para que la: Adjust the seat and backrest so the handles are at chest level. Sit down and grab the handles with a firm grip. Press the handles forward until your arms are almost extended. Slowly return to the starting position, staying in control.
Ajusta el banco a un ángulo de 30-45 gra: Set the bench to an angle of 30-45 degrees. Lie back on the bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press up until your arms are extended.

Set the bench to an angle of 30-45 degrees. Sit down and plant your feet firmly on the floor. Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip and bring them to chest level. Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost extended, then lower slowly.
Ajusta el banco a una posición declinada: Set the bench to a decline position and make sure it is secure. Lie on the bench with your feet firmly anchored and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar slowly to your chest, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle. Press the bar up until your arms are fully extended, without locking your elbows.
Ajusta el banco predicador a una altura: Set the preacher bench to a comfortable height and sit with your chest against the pad. Hold the bar or dumbbells with an underhand grip, arms extended. Bend your elbows to curl the weight toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows fixed. Lower slowly back to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la altura de las poleas a nivel d: Set the pulleys at chest height and select the right weight. Stand in the center, grab the handles with your palms facing down and step forward. With your elbows slightly bent, press the handles forward until your arms are extended. Slowly return to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la altura del asiento para que tu: Adjust the seat height so your legs are slightly bent as you pedal. Place your feet on the pedals and adjust the safety straps if needed. Start pedaling at a comfortable pace, keeping your back straight and your shoulders relaxed.

Adjust the seat height so your feet reach the pedals comfortably. Put your hands on the handles and sit upright. Start pedaling while pushing and pulling the handles at the same time. Keep a steady pace and control your breathing.
Ajusta la máquina a tu altura y siéntate: Adjust the machine to your height and sit with your back against the backrest. Plant your feet firmly on the floor and set the pad over your hips. Drive up through your hips, squeezing your glutes at the top. Slowly lower your hips back to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la máquina para que el cojín esté: Adjust the machine so the pad sits just above your ankles. Sit down and make sure your back is against the backrest. Grip the handles and bend your knees, bringing the pad toward your glutes. Slowly return to the starting position without letting the weight slam down.
Ajusta la polea a la altura de los hombr: Set the pulley at shoulder height and hold the handles with an overhand grip. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your elbows slightly bent. Press the handles up until your arms are fully extended, staying in control. Slowly return to the start, without letting the weight plates crash.
Ajusta la polea a la altura de tu cara y: Set the cable at face height and hold the handles with an overhand grip. Step back to put tension on the cable and place your feet shoulder-width apart. Pull the handles toward your face, keeping your elbows high and out wide. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta la polea a la altura más baja y c: Set the pulley to its lowest height and attach an ankle strap to one ankle. Hold on to the machine for balance. With your leg straight, push back until you feel your glutes contract. Slowly return to the start without letting the weight touch the stack.
Ajusta la polea a la altura más baja y s: Set the pulley to its lowest height and hold the handle with both hands. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight. Descend into a squat, sending your hips back and keeping your knees in line with your feet. Return to the start by pushing through your heels while keeping control of the cable.
Ajusta la polea a la posición más alta y: Set the cable to the highest position and grab the handle with both hands. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, torso turned toward the cable. Pull the handle down and across your body, rotating your torso and slightly bending your knees. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.

Set the pulley to its highest position and hold the rope with both hands. Stand with one foot in front of the other for stability. Extend your arms up and forward, keeping your elbows close to your head. Slowly return to the start without moving your elbows.
Ajusta la polea a la posición más baja y: Set the pulley to its lowest position and hold the handle with both hands, palms facing down. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and keep a slight bend in your knees. Raise the handle forward until your arms are parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows slightly bent. Slowly lower the handle back to the start, staying in control.

Set the pulley to its lowest position and hold the handle with both hands. Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your core braced. Pull the handle up, driving your elbows out to the sides and higher than your hands. Slowly lower the handle back to the start, staying in control.

Set the cable to the lowest position and hold the handle with one hand. Stand sideways to the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your arm out to the side until it's at shoulder height, keeping your elbow slightly bent. Slowly lower your arm to the starting position and repeat.

Set the pulley to its lowest position and hold the bar with an underhand grip. Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your elbows tucked against your body. Bend your elbows to curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows still. Slowly lower the bar back to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la polea a una altura alta y enga: Set the cable to a high position and attach a straight bar. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grab the bar with your palms facing down. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and push the bar down until your arms are fully extended. Slowly return the bar to the starting position without moving your elbows.
Ajusta la polea a una altura alta y suje: Set the pulley high and hold the rope with both hands. Kneel facing the machine, keeping your back straight. Bend your torso forward, bringing your elbows toward your knees as you contract your abs. Slowly return to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la polea a una posición alta y su: Set the cable to a high position and hold the rope with both hands. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, leaning slightly forward. Pull the rope down toward your body, keeping your arms straight with a slight bend in your elbows. Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the movement.
Ajusta la polea baja a la altura de tu t: Set the low pulley at ankle height and put the strap on your outside ankle. Stand sideways to the machine, holding on with one hand for balance. With the strapped leg, extend out to the side, keeping your torso upright. Slowly return to the start and repeat.
Ajusta la resistencia y la inclinación a: Set the resistance and incline to a comfortable level. Place your feet on the pedals and grab the handles. Start moving your feet in an elliptical motion, keeping an upright posture. Gradually increase the speed and resistance according to your fitness level.
Ajusta la resistencia y sujeta las manij: Set the resistance and grip the handles firmly. Lean your torso slightly forward, keeping your back straight. Pull the handles down and back, extending your arms and engaging your upper back and triceps. Slowly return to the start, staying in control.
Ajusta la velocidad e inclinación de la: Set the treadmill's speed and incline to a comfortable level. Keep an upright, relaxed posture as you walk or run. Use a natural stride, landing softly on your heel. Keep a steady pace and breathe regularly.
Ajusta las poleas a la altura de los hom: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and select the right weight. Take a handle in each hand and step forward, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Bring your hands together in front of you, squeezing your chest, then slowly return to the start.
Ajusta las poleas bajas a la posición má: Set the low pulleys to their lowest position and hold the handles with your palms facing up. Step forward, keeping a slight forward lean and your feet shoulder-width apart. With your elbows slightly bent, raise the handles up and toward the center of your body until your hands meet at chest height. Slowly return to the start, staying in control.
Alternating: one arm, then the other.
Alternar 4 min suave y 2 min moderado: Alternate 4 min easy and 2 min moderate
Anclar los pies y tirar con los flexores: Anchoring your feet and pulling with your hip flexors.
Apoya el antebrazo en el marco de la pue: Rest your forearm on the door frame with your elbow at shoulder height. Step forward with the foot on the same side. Rotate your torso away from that arm until you feel the stretch in your chest. Hold, breathing deeply, then switch arms.
Apoya la parte alta de la espalda en un: Rest your upper back on a bench, with a barbell or plate across your hips (use a pad). Feet flat on the floor. Drive your hips up, squeezing your glutes, until your torso is parallel to the floor, then lower with control. The glute bridge is the floor version, without a bench.
Apoya las dos manos en la pared a la alt: Place both hands on the wall at shoulder height. Take a long step back with one leg, with your foot pointing straight ahead and your heel on the floor. Lean toward the wall by bending your front leg while keeping the back leg straight. Hold, feeling the stretch in your calf, then switch legs.
Apoya las manos en el suelo a un palmo d: Place your hands on the floor a hand's width from the wall, with your arms straight and your hands shoulder-width apart. Kick your legs up in a controlled way until your heels rest against the wall. Stack your hands, shoulders and hips vertically, with your abs and glutes squeezed. Hold while breathing steadily and bring one leg down first to come out.
Apoya los antebrazos y las puntas de los: Rest your forearms and toes on the floor, elbows under your shoulders. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, squeezing your abs and glutes. Hold for the set time, breathing normally. It is not about reps: it is about holding the position.
Apoya una mano en una mesa o una silla f: Rest one hand on a table or a sturdy chair, back straight. With the other hand, hold a water bottle or a bag and pull it up toward your hip, driving your elbow back and keeping it close to your body. Lower slowly. Reps are per arm.
Apoya una rodilla en el suelo y coloca e: Kneel on one knee and place your other foot in front, with the knee at 90 degrees. Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of your back leg. Push your hips forward until you feel the stretch in the front of the hip of the kneeling leg. Raise the arm on that side to deepen it, hold, and switch legs.
Apoyar el codo adelantado o atrasado en: Placing your elbow too far forward or back instead of right under your shoulder.
Placing your elbow ahead of your shoulder.
Apoyar el cuello en vez de la parte alta: Resting your neck on the bench instead of your upper back.
Putting your weight on the back leg.
Apoyar el pie entero adelante en vez de: Planting your whole foot forward instead of just bringing your knee closer.
Apoyar las manos por delante de los homb: Placing your hands ahead of your shoulders.
Apoyar los pies demasiado lejos: entonce: Placing your feet too far away: then your hamstrings take over.
Putting all your weight on your arms.
Aprender a mantener la zona lumbar neutr: Learn to keep your lower back neutral and breathe without losing tension. Everything is static or very controlled. Rest 45 seconds.
Aprender los movimientos con máquinas gu: Learn the movements on guided machines with moderate volume. Upper body / lower body split.
Aprender los patrones con técnica limpia: Learn the patterns with clean technique and build the habit. Rest 60 to 90 seconds, without going to failure. If floor push-ups do not work yet, put your hands on the table or the sofa: they count the same.
Apretar la barra hasta que solo aguanta: Squeezing the bar until only your forearms are holding on.
Arching your lower back as you press.
Arquear la lumbar al llevar el peso atrá: Arching your lower back as you take the weight back.
Arquear la lumbar arriba en vez de apret: Arching your lower back at the top instead of squeezing your glutes.
Arquear la lumbar en el dead bug: debe q: Arching your lower back in the dead bug: it should stay pressed into the floor.
Arquear la lumbar en la rueda (empieza c: Arching your lower back on the ab wheel (start with a short range).
Arquear la lumbar en vez de la espalda a: Arching your lower back instead of your upper back.
Arquear la lumbar en vez de meter la pel: Arching your lower back instead of tucking your pelvis.
Arquear la lumbar para compensar la falt: Arching your lower back to make up for limited shoulder mobility.
Arching your lower back to press.
Arquear la lumbar para ganar estiramient: Arching your lower back to get more stretch.
Arquear la lumbar para llevar el peso at: Arching your lower back to take the weight behind you.
Arquear la lumbar para subir más la pier: Arching your lower back to raise your leg higher.
Arching your lower back and ending up in a banana shape.
Arquear la zona lumbar al estirarse: es: Arching your lower back as you stretch: it is the sign you have gone too far.
Arquear la zona lumbar al estirarte: es: Arching your lower back as you reach out: this is the mistake that causes injury.
Arquear la zona lumbar en vez de empujar: Arching your lower back instead of pushing with your glute.
Arquear la zona lumbar: debe quedar pega: Arching your lower back: it should stay pressed into the floor the whole time.
Arching your back too much as you push.
Arrodíllate detrás de un banco plano y a: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest both forearms along the bench, with your hands hanging off the edge. Grip the bar with your palms facing up, shoulder-width apart, and let your wrists drop. Raise the bar by curling only your wrists, keeping your forearms against the bench at all times. Slowly lower the bar to the start and repeat.

Kneel behind a flat bench and rest both forearms along the bench, with your hands hanging off the edge. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up and let your wrists drop. Curl your wrists up without lifting your forearms off the bench. Slowly lower the dumbbells to the start and repeat.
Arrodíllate frente a un banco bajo y apo: Kneel in front of a low bench and rest your elbows on it, with your hands together. Keep your hips above your knees and your abs engaged. Sink your chest toward the floor, letting your upper back extend. Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply, then return to the neutral position.
Asegura tus tobillos bajo un soporte o p: Secure your ankles under a support or have a partner hold them. Start on your knees, with your body straight from your knees to your head. Slowly lower yourself forward, staying in control, until you can't hold it any longer without falling. Use your hands to catch yourself and push off lightly to return to the start.
Slamming your heel down on landing.
Landing with your knees caving in.
Ayudarte con las piernas cuando aún pued: Helping with your legs when you could still do it with your arms.
Añadir tiempo cada semana: 30 seg, 1 min: Add time each week: 30 s, 1 min, 2 min...
Bajada controlada y profunda, explosión: Controlled, deep descent, maximum explosion upward, land with soft knees.
Bajada controlada, pecho toca el suelo,: Controlled descent, chest touches the floor, push up with tension, no bouncing or half reps, do not lock your elbows at the top.
Bajar el codo en vez de mantener el braz: Dropping your elbow instead of keeping your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Dropping the weight all at once.
Bajar la barbilla al pecho en vez de des: Dropping your chin to your chest instead of sliding your head back.
Lowering the bar to your forehead without control.
Bajar la barra demasiado alta, hacia el: Lowering the bar too high, toward your sternum.
Bajar las piernas de golpe o despegar la: Dropping your legs all at once or lifting your lower back off the floor.
Dropping your elbows (it turns into a row).
Bajar los codos por detrás de la línea d: Lowering your elbows behind the line of your body.
Dropping your elbows behind your body.
Going lower than your knee can handle.

Túmbate boca arriba con las rodillas dob: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to make a figure four. Túmbate boca arriba con los brazos estir: Lie on your back with your arms straight toward the ceiling and your knees bent at 90° (like a bug on its back, hence the name). Press your lower back into the floor and, without losing that contact, slowly lower one arm behind your head and the opposite leg, extending it toward the floor. Return to the center and repeat on the opposite side. It's reps alternating sides; control matters, not speed.
Túmbate boca arriba con una pierna estir: Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor. Loop a strap or towel around the sole of the other foot and hold it with both hands. Túmbate boca arriba y pega la zona lumba: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor. Reach your arms overhead and raise your straight legs a few inches off the floor. Lift your head and shoulder blades too, making a banana shape with your body. Hold the position without letting your lower back come off the floor; if it's too hard, bend your knees.
Túmbate de lado con las piernas estirada: Lie on your side with your legs straight, one on top of the other, and rest your forearm on the floor with your elbow right under your shoulder. Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from feet to head and hold for the set time, breathing normally. When done, switch sides: the time shown is per side.
Túmbate de lado con las rodillas doblada: Lie on your side with your knees bent at 90 degrees, one on top of the other. Reach both arms straight out in front of you, together, at shoulder height. Open the top arm in a semicircle toward the floor on the other side, rotating your upper back. Keep your knees down, hold for a few seconds, then switch sides.

Una SUPERSERIE significa hacer dos ejerc: A SUPERSET means doing two exercises back to back WITH NO rest between them, and resting only after both.
